comment: Home Datacenter Govulncheck Audited Exemption Allowlist for Go 1.26.4 Standard Library

exemptions.summary: HTTP/1 server crash due to MaxBytesReader header race in net/http
exemptions.reason: Internal API reverse proxied behind nginx/gateway with header limits; MaxBytesReader race requires concurrent malicious HTTP/1 body reading during keep-alive shutdown.

exemptions.summary: Certificate policy constraint verification issue in crypto/x509
exemptions.reason: Internal TLS communication uses mutual TLS or private CA certificates without complex public web PKI policy trees.

exemptions.summary: ReadResponse memory or parsing edge cases in net/http
exemptions.reason: Only outbound requests to trusted internal endpoints (e.g. Frigate, Mosquitto) use ReadResponse.

exemptions.summary: Transport read edge case in net/http
exemptions.reason: HTTP client connections configured with strict context timeouts and response limits.

exemptions.summary: HTTP/2 stream handling edge case in net/http
exemptions.reason: Internal HTTP server uses HTTP/1.1 or proxy-terminated HTTP/2 with request timeout protection.

exemptions.summary: HTTP connection teardown race in net/http
exemptions.reason: Service operates within isolated container networking; idle connection limits enforced.

exemptions.summary: Header parsing edge case in net/http
exemptions.reason: Sanitized by Gin framework and reverse proxy frontends.
Cookie handling is restricted to session validation with max length limits.

exemptions.summary: Multipart parsing memory consumption in mime/multipart
exemptions.reason: File uploads are bound by MaxMultipartMemory (32MB) and body size limits.

exemptions.summary: TLS session resumption edge case in crypto/tls
exemptions.reason: Mutual TLS and internal connections do not rely on vulnerable session ticket resumption patterns.

exemptions.summary: ReverseProxy hop-by-hop header forwarding issue in net/http/httputil
exemptions.reason: ReverseProxy in home-datacenter explicitly rewrites headers and strips untrusted upstream headers.

exemptions.summary: Chunked transfer encoding parsing issue in net/http
exemptions.reason: Inbound requests to backend services have chunked encoding normalized by ingress proxy.

exemptions.summary: Avoid quadratic complexity in resolvePath in net/url
exemptions.reason: Parsed URLs are bounded in length and originates from internal API route handlers.

exemptions.summary: Limit handshake messages accepted post-handshake in crypto/tls
exemptions.reason: Server TLS config enforces standard TLS 1.2/1.3 without renegotiation.

exemptions.summary: Apply ReadHeaderTimeout when doing unencrypted HTTP/2 check in net/http
exemptions.reason: http.Server instances in cmd/main.go and cmd/host-helper/main.go configure ReadTimeout=30s and ReadHeaderTimeout.

exemptions.summary: Add recursion depth guard during decode in encoding/xml
exemptions.reason: XML decoding is strictly limited to small WebDAV propfind responses from internal Nextcloud/NAS endpoints.

exemptions.summary: Enforce maximum recursion depth in encoding/asn1
exemptions.reason: Used only for parsing locally pinned RSA/ECDSA public keys in operations client.

exemptions.summary: Encrypted Client Hello privacy leak in crypto/tls
exemptions.reason: Encrypted Client Hello (ECH) is not enabled or required on internal datacenter network.

exemptions.summary: Failure to reject ASCII-only Punycode-encoded labels in IDNA
exemptions.reason: Internal services use IP addresses or alphanumeric internal hostnames, not internationalized domain names (IDN).
